name: Input Buffer
description: Practice tool for click patterns, with a lookahead for wave, ship, UFO and swing. Buffer and Snap only work in practice mode or from a start position.

enabled.name: Enabled
enabled.description: Turns Buffer and Snap on or off. Your best run is still saved while off.

mode.name: Mode
mode.description:
Buffer: hold early presses until the player can act. On wave, ship, UFO and swing, the mod simulates the path ahead and holds a click or release that would crash until the best step to fire it. Ship, UFO and swing physics are learned from a few seconds of flying first.
Snap to best run: a click that comes within the snap window before a click from your best run is held and fired at the right moment. Every other click works as normal. Your furthest attempt from each start position is saved as the best run automatically.
Buffer and Snap only work in practice mode or from a start position.

buffer-frames.name: Buffer Frames
buffer-frames.description: How many physics steps a press is held while the player cannot act yet, or, on wave, ship, UFO and swing, how many steps late a click or release may be fired to avoid a crash. 0 disables buffering.

wave-lookahead.name: Lookahead
wave-lookahead.description: Buffer mode, wave, ship, UFO and swing: how many physics steps ahead the mod checks the path after a click or release. Longer sees obstacles sooner but holds more clicks that only crash because you would have let go in time. At 240 steps per second, 48 steps is 0.2 seconds.

snap-window.name: Snap Window
snap-window.description: Snap mode: how many physics steps before a click from your best run your click may come and still be moved onto it. At 240 steps per second, 4 steps is about one frame at 60 FPS.

path-tolerance.name: Path Tolerance
path-tolerance.description: Snap mode: how far (in game units, 30 = one block) the player may be from where the best run was on the same step and still get snapped. Further off the path, clicks work as normal.

show-click-info.name: Show Click Info
show-click-info.description: Show what the mod did with your last click, and why, under the corner label. Every decision is also written to the Geode log.

show-wave-prediction.name: Show Prediction
show-wave-prediction.description: On each wave, ship, UFO or swing click, draw what the mod predicted: your hitbox (white), the path if the click fires now (red if it crashes, green if not), the path at the delay it chose (yellow), the hazards it checked (orange) and the blocks and slope surfaces it checked (cyan). Details, including the learned physics, are also written to the Geode log.

toggle-key.name: Toggle Hotkey
toggle-key.description: Turn the mod on or off. Only works in practice mode or from a start position.

more-help-key.name: More Help Hotkey
more-help-key.description: Add one step to the buffer (Buffer mode) or snap window (Snap mode).

less-help-key.name: Less Help Hotkey
less-help-key.description: Remove one step from the buffer (Buffer mode) or snap window (Snap mode).
